item.title: YTKillerPlus v21.36.6
item.description:
YouTube 21.36.6 | YouTube_21.36_YTKillerPlus_6.5
• v21.34 requires iOS 17 and later now • Fix HLS CKU clear known url for audio mp3 and 2k-4k capable devices fails on v21.31+ in some cases • Fix save posted gif image saving only first frame in some cases • Fix save posted image when multiple imge in a post first image not saved correctly • Fix tabs Icon. • Fix and improve audio languages select. • Updated iPA to newer YouTube v21.34.6. • Add POST tab to tab bar. • Improve localization & add missing languages. • Improve ad blocking on main Feed. • Improve Lyrics API speed & accuracy. • Improve MP3 audio handling. • Improve backup & restore. • Improve media extension importing. • Improve Shorts auto-skip. • Improve Shorts multiple-post handling. • Fix OLED keyboard issue on iOS 27. • Other fixes & cleanup. • Updated iPA to YouTube v21.36
